name: Buckland Saint Mary
description: A town in Somerset never visited by faeries because pixies annihilated them in a war; valuable to magi researching the battlefield.

name: Somerset
description: English region containing the town of Buckland Saint Mary.

name: Purgatory of Saint Patrick
description: A major Irish pilgrimage site beneath an island on Lough Dearg containing a gate to Purgatory established by Saint Patrick.

name: Purgatory
description: Afterlife state/place where souls suffer for unrepented sins before reaching the Earthly Paradise; here a Tartaran Infernal regio of level 8 ruled by Pasiel.

name: Lough Dearg
description: A red-tinged lake ('red lake') in northwest Ireland in Tír Chonaill with forty-six islands, site of the Purgatory of Saint Patrick.

name: Ireland
description: Island where the Purgatory of Saint Patrick is one of the most important pilgrimage sites.

name: Donegal
description: Region of Ireland where Saint Patrick preached his ministry.

name: Kingdom of Tír Chonaill
description: Irish kingdom in the northwest of Ireland containing Lough Dearg.

name: Inisphadraig
description: Largest island on Lough Dearg, named after Saint Patrick, home to an Augustinian chapter house with a Dominion aura of 3 (4 within the house).

name: Inisnaoimh
description: Saint's Island on Lough Dearg, with an Empyreal aura of 4 and a small church whose crypt cell holds the entrance to Purgatory.

name: Abbey of Saints Peter and Paul
description: Mother house in Armagh of the Augustinian canons of Patrick's Island.

name: Armagh
description: Irish town, home of the motherhouse of the canons guarding Lough Dearg and a required stop for pilgrims to the Purgatory.

name: Earthly Paradise
description: Home of the boni non valde where purged souls wait in bliss for Judgment Day; a Celestial regio of level 8 ruled by the Archangel Shamshiel.

name: Heaven
description: The Heavenly Paradise, the Divine Realm, destination of the saved (boni); entered from the Earthly Paradise.

name: Hell
description: Destination of the damned (mali); its entrance lies in Purgatory at the Mouth of Hell.

name: Field of Chains
description: First field of Purgatory where the slothful lie chained face down while Iurgatores walk on them.

name: Field of Nails
description: Field of Purgatory where sinners of self-indulgence are pinned with red hot nails and bitten by adders.

name: Field of Hooks
description: Field of Purgatory where perpetrators of fraud hang from hooks over flames.

name: Wheel of Fire
description: Field of Purgatory where the covetous are burned on an immense turning wheel.

name: Mountain of Blood
description: Field of Purgatory where the violent are blasted by icy wind and hurled into a river of filth.

name: House of Flames and Smoke
description: Stone hall in Purgatory with pits of molten metal punishing perverse appetites and violence against God.

name: The Furnace
description: Furnace beneath the House of Flames and Smoke, source of Purgatory's flames, which transmogrifies things burnt in it and grants insight into the Limits of Essential Nature and Vis.

name: Abyssal Pit
description: Field of Purgatory punishing pride with total sensory deprivation in an infinite fall.

name: Boiling River
description: River of sulfur and blood in Purgatory where traitors are thrown; it flows into the Mouth of Hell.

name: Mouth of Hell
description: Entrance to Hell in Purgatory, a mountain-sized beast's mouth guarded by two seraphim.

name: Bridge to Paradise
description: Knife-thin rock bridge over the Boiling River that is a regio boundary into the Earthly Paradise, widening for the repentant.

name: Gate of Paradise
description: Golden jeweled gate at the end of the Bridge to Paradise where angels heal and clothe visitors.

name: Fountain of Youth
description: White marble fountain in a grove of black poplars near the Boiling River whose water restores youth, removes Warping, and grants Unaging.

name: Tree of Life
description: Tree in the Earthly Paradise; trying to eat from it draws Shamshiel's attention.

name: Mirror of Souls
description: Mirror in the Abyssal Pit that reveals and scries anyone named or sympathetically connected, with Penetration 50; a source of insight for Original Research.

name: Cennet
description: Sinkhole ('heaven') in Asia Minor in the Tribunal of the Levant with a monastery at its bottom founded by Saint Paulus.

name: Cehennem
description: Sinkhole ('hell') linked by tunnel to Cennet; said to be bottomless, once a prison of Typhon, leading to Purgatory.

name: Asia Minor
description: Region whose coast holds the sinkholes Cennet and Cehennem.

name: Cyprus
description: Island south of the sinkholes of Cennet and Cehennem.

name: Cape Tainaron
description: Southernmost point of mainland Greece in Achaea; its church was a nekromanteion to Hades and a cave beneath leads to Purgatory or the pagan dead.

name: Principality of Achaea
description: Greek principality containing Cape Tainaron.

name: Lake Avernus
description: Circular sulfurous lake on the Bay of Naples in the Roman Tribunal, connected by tunnel to Cumae.

name: Bay of Naples
description: Bay on which Lake Avernus lies.

name: Cumae
description: Abandoned Greek colony where the Cumaean sibyl Carmentis guards a gate into Purgatory.

name: Mount Etna
description: Volcano where Typhon was imprisoned, home of magic spirits, possibly hiding a gateway to Purgatory.

name: Garden of Eden
description: Often equated with the Earthly Paradise; optionally lies within it in a Celestial regio of level 10, guarded by cherubim.

name: Circuit of Saint Patrick
description: Pilgrimage itinerary through sites of Saint Patrick's miracles ending at Lough Dearg.

name: Downpatrick
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Vale of Angels
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Saulpatrick
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Maghera
description: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

name: Ulaid
description: Irish region covered in The Contested Isle; Brother Bressal's Gaelic specialty.

name: Basingwerk Abbey
description: Abbey associated with Henricus and Abbot Gilbert, sources of the Tractatus.

name: Fallen Temple of Mercury
description: Ruined Cult of Mercury temple complex the size of a town hidden in a Magic regio of aura 5, built by Julius Caesar and rebuilt by Augustus.

name: Triumphal Arch
description: Ruined Roman arch bearing carvings of Augustus and Mercury that must be rebuilt to enter the temple regio.

name: Decumanus
description: The 500-pace north-south main street of the temple town.

name: Cardus
description: The east-west main street of the temple town bisecting the Decumanus.

name: Amphitheater of the Temple Town
description: Ruined arena in the northwest of the temple town, whose labyrinth beneath houses the Maze Beast.

name: Aventine Hill
description: Hill in Rome near which Bonisagus found a cache of Cult of Mercury rituals.

name: Rome
description: City where Bonisagus found Mercurian ritual texts; possible location of the temple.

name: Magvillus
description: Site where Fenicil's collection of Mercurian rituals is reputedly kept in a secret trove.

name: Harco
description: Domus magna of House Mercere, rumored to be built on top of the temple ruins.

name: Roman Empire
description: Ancient empire in which the Cult of Mercury flourished; its western collapse ended the Cult.

name: Byzantine Empire
description: Empire under which the nekromanteion at Taenerus was converted to a church.

name: North Africa
description: Region outside the Order's territory once within the late Roman Republic.

name: Tribunal of the Levant
description: Tribunal containing Cennet and Cehennem; within the late Roman Republic's territory.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing Lake Avernus.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Irish Tribunal where a covenant losing its trophy for a year and a day ceases to be a covenant.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: Tribunal largely within the late Roman Republic's territory.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal largely within the late Roman Republic's territory.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal largely within the late Roman Republic's territory.

name: Provençal Tribunal
description: Tribunal largely within the late Roman Republic's territory.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal largely within the late Roman Republic's territory.

name: House Verditius
description: Hermetic House of item-crafters; a Verditius magus seeks to smelt arsenic into metal.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House whose few Gifted magi claim to be priests of Mercury; its domus magna is Harco.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House whose second Primus Fenicil gathered Mercurian rituals; its members guard them.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, considered by many to have the Cult of Mercury as its prototype.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Roman magical priesthood that tore itself apart as the Western Empire collapsed; seen as a prototype for the Order of Hermes.

name: Cult of Jupiter
description: Roman cult whose high priest was the Pontifex Maximus.

name: Augustinian Canons Regular
description: Order of canons ('Black Canons') established on Inisphadraig by Saint Malachy who tend the Purgatory of Saint Patrick.

name: Guardians of Purgatory
description: Small Holy Tradition favoring Meditation, Purity, Understanding, and Intervention that guards the gate to Purgatory.

name: Patrician monks
description: Monks who dwelt on Inisphadraig before the Augustinian chapter and taught Divine magic to the guardians.

name: Seekers
description: Magi with a special interest in the Cult of Mercury and lost lore.

name: Accusers
description: Order of demons to which the Iurgatores belong.

name: Avengers of Evil
description: Order of demons (angels of punishment) of which Pasiel is a Duke.

name: Church
description: The Christian Church, including the Irish Church; has given no definitive word on Purgatory's location.

name: Saint Patrick
description: Saint who banished the peist and all serpents from Ireland and was shown the entrance to Purgatory by Christ.

name: Saint Malachy
description: Established the Augustinian chapter house on Inisphadraig in 1130.

name: Brother Bressal
description: Augustinian canon and guardian of the Purgatory of Saint Patrick with True Faith and Divine Form, who opens the gate to Purgatory.

name: Saint Augustine
description: Described the four-fold division of the afterlife and treated Purgatory as a state rather than a place.

name: Christ
description: Appeared to Saint Patrick and gave him a book of gospels and a staff.

name: Silver Lady
description: Figure of local tales about the poisoned battlefield, with powers and servants.

name: Carmentis
description: The Cumaean sibyl, a Christian Magic Human with vast knowledge who guards a gate into Purgatory at Cumae.

name: Saint Paulus
description: Founded the monastery at the bottom of Cennet.

name: Virgin Mary
description: Dedicatee of the monastery in Cennet.

name: Zeus
description: Pagan god who imprisoned Typhon under Mount Etna.

name: Hades
description: Pagan god of the dead to whom the nekromanteion at Taenerus was dedicated.

name: Sir Owain
description: Knight (originally an Irish monk Owain) whose journey through Purgatory to the Earthly Paradise is the basis of the legend.

name: Gilbert of Basingwerk
description: Abbot of Basingwerk to whom Owain told his vision.

name: H. of Sawtrey
description: Anonymous monk who wrote the Tractatus de Purgatorio Sancti Patricii around 1160, perhaps Henricus of Basingwerk.

name: Marie of France
description: Author of L'espurgatoire Seint Patriz in Norman French.

name: Tundal
description: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

name: Thurkell
description: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

name: Gunthelm
description: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

name: Judas Iscariot
description: Archetypal traitor whose sins are punished in the Boiling River.

name: Bonisagus
description: Discovered a cache of Cult of Mercury rituals near the Aventine Hill, informing his Hermetic theory.

name: Fenicil
description: Second Primus of House Guernicus who collected Mercurian rituals and wrote The Cult of Mercury.

name: Mercere
description: Founder of House Mercere, supposed author of Roman Astrological Correspondences of Mercury.

name: Mercury
description: Roman god worshipped by the Cult of Mercury, depicted on the triumphal arch.

name: Julius Caesar
description: Founded the first temple of Mercury in the regio in 46 BC.

name: Augustus
description: Octavian, invested as Antistes Mercuria in 11 BC, who rebuilt the temple of Mercury as a massive complex.

name: Mark Anthony
description: Octavian's rival in the civil war during which Julius' temple was destroyed.

name: Tiberius
description: Inherited the title Antistes Mercuria in 14 AD.

name: Caligula
description: Tiberius' heir who did not inherit the title Antistes Mercuria.

name: Commodus
description: Emperor whose murder in 192 AD led to civil war and the temple's decline.

name: Septimius Severus
description: Emperor triumphant in the civil war after 192 AD.

name: Constantine
description: Emperor who made Christianity the state religion in 313 AD, after which the temple was abandoned.

name: Athenaeus
description: Second-century author of Edicts of Augustus.

name: Pandius
description: A demon suggested for summoning by diabolists at the poisoned battlefield.

name: Peist
description: Immense serpent-like monster of Lough Dearg banished by Saint Patrick; its blood tinges the lake red.

name: Pixie
description: Fey beings of Buckland Saint Mary who annihilated the faeries and know traditional wards.

name: Will-o-the-wisp
description: Beings allied with (or become by) the pixies who can lead characters through the forest.

name: Poisonous elemental
description: Elemental liberated by disturbing the poisoned battlefield that raids the mundane world.

name: Iurgatores
description: Quarrelsome bullying demons of the order of Accusers who torment sinners in Purgatory.

name: Pasiel
description: Duke of Purgatory, an angel of punishment treated as a demon (Infernal Might 40) who can manipulate time.

name: Shamshiel
description: Archangel ruling the Earthly Paradise with Divine Might 75.

name: Xaphan
description: The Forge-Man of Hell, occasionally found at the Furnace.

name: Seraphim
description: Mighty angels guarding the Mouth of Hell.

name: Cherubim
description: Angels with flaming swords guarding the entrances to Eden.

name: Typhon
description: Mythic being temporarily imprisoned in Cehennem before Mount Etna.

name: Beelzebub
description: Demon whose son is among rumored hidden objects in Purgatory.

name: Maze Beast
description: Immortal minotaur arena gladiator (Magic Might 10) lairing beneath the ruined amphitheater of the temple town.

name: Demon
description: Infernal beings who torment souls in Purgatory.

name: Angel
description: Divine beings; an angel dresses visitors at the Gate of Paradise and may guard the Fountain of Youth.

name: Faerie
description: Beings of the battlefield able to spirit humans away; annihilated at Buckland Saint Mary.

name: Soul
description: Human souls in Purgatory and Paradise have a Might Score, no Decrepitude or Warping, and Abilities capped at half Might.

name: Ghost
description: Spirit that remains on or returns to earth; a template for characters not resurrected into a body.

name: Drowned Men
description: Character template for those resurrected by a magical patron.

name: Sibyl
description: Prophetic Magic Human such as the Cumaean sibyl.

name: Diabolist
description: Infernal worshippers who meet at the battlefield to summon a demon.

name: Pilgrim
description: Penitent travelers who enter Purgatory for remission of sins.

name: Arsenic
description: Poison found in the soil of the battlefield; valuable to necromancers and a potential metal with Material Bonuses.

name: Metallic arsenic
description: Brittle metal smelted from arsenic salts with Material Bonuses for killing magic, preservation of the dead, and stimulating the ill.

name: First Inscription
description: Inscription providing guaranteed Insight for Original Research.

name: Second Inscription
description: Scroll inscription in a strange language and mystical ink that can be cast and provides Insight.

name: Tractatus de Purgatorio Sancti Patricii
description: Latin account (c.1160) of Owain's Vision; tractatus on Area Lore: Purgatory Q7 and summa on Theology L3 Q8.

name: L'espurgatoire Seint Patriz
description: Norman French tractatus by Marie of France on Area Lore: Purgatory, Quality 9.

name: Sir Owain (poem)
description: Middle English poem, basis of the Vision of Hell and Heaven, with the later Owayne Miles.

name: The Cult of Mercury (book)
description: Fenicil's ninth-century tractatus on Organization Lore: Cult of Mercury, Quality 8.

name: Edicts of Augustus
description: Athenaeus' second-century tractatus on Civil and Canon Law recording Augustus' investiture.

name: The Annals of Mercury
description: Summa by Mercurian priests detailing the temple's history (Level 3, Quality 10).

name: Roman Astrological Correspondences of Mercury
description: Tractatus attributed to Mercere with a horoscope of Augustus' investiture.

name: Covenant trophy
description: Hibernian tradition that a covenant losing its trophy for a year and a day is no longer a covenant.

name: Schism War
description: Hermetic war of which the battlefield and the War of the Faeries and Pixies are representations.

name: War of the Faeries and the Pixies
description: Faerie representation of the Schism War in which pixies annihilated faeries at Buckland Saint Mary.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Magical link to a person or thing; poison retains a connection to the site.

name: Sympathetic Connection
description: Connection on which the Mirror of Souls can operate.

name: Material Bonuses
description: Magical properties of materials used in enchanting items.

name: Original Research
description: Hermetic research into breakthroughs aided by Insight sources.

name: Insight
description: Guaranteed inspiration from a source granting breakthrough points in Original Research.

name: Magic aura
description: Supernatural aura of the Magic Realm; the temple regio has aura 5.

name: Dominion aura
description: Divine aura from worship; 3 on Inisphadraig.

name: Empyreal aura
description: Divine auras not derived from worship; level 4 on Inisnaoimh.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural layered area; the Purgatory and temple lie in regiones.

name: Tartaran regio
description: Infernal regio of hellfire where Fatigue cannot be recovered.

name: Celestial regio
description: Home of angels; visitors risk disorientation, Fatigue, Warping, and Ascension.

name: Faith Point
description: Points of Divine favor spent on miracles or to succeed on rolls.

name: Divine Form
description: Effect of Divine Ascent giving Brother Bressal a Commanding Aura.

name: Divine magic
description: Holy magic taught to guardians of Purgatory.

name: Holy Tradition
description: Tradition of Divine magic with favored Methods and Powers.

name: Miraculous Effects
description: Divine magic effects with Office duration and Presence range.

name: Vision of Hell
description: Guided journey through Purgatory's fields of torment.

name: Vision of Heaven
description: Reward of glimpsing the Earthly Paradise after Purgatory.

name: Office for the Dead
description: Mass performed as a rite of imitation of death before entering Purgatory.

name: Limit of Essential Nature
description: Hermetic limit the Furnace seems to violate.

name: Limit of Vis
description: Hermetic limit the Furnace seems to violate.

name: Limit of Arcane Connections
description: Hermetic limit the Mirror of Souls may help bypass.

name: Limit of the Infernal
description: Hermetic limit the Mirror of Souls may give insight into.

name: Limit of Aging
description: Hermetic limit the Fountain of Youth may give insight into.

name: Limit of Warping
description: Hermetic limit the Fountain of Youth may give insight into.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power; vis thrown into the Furnace becomes Ignem vis.

name: Vis sordida
description: Infernal vis; Iurgatores carry 3 pawns in their hooks.

name: Vis prava
description: Infernal vis; Pasiel carries 8 pawns in his scourge.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural distortion accumulated in auras; removable by the Fountain of Youth.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic state magi may enter; a comprehended Twilight is a possible effect of Ascent.

name: Ascension
description: Divine Ascent triggered by Warping in Celestial regiones.

name: Pilgrimage
description: Journey to petition God for remission of sins, tested by Oppositional Elements.

name: Oppositional Elements
description: Physical and spiritual tests encountered during a pilgrimage.

name: Mali non valde
description: The not completely evil, whose destination is Purgatory.

name: Boni non valde
description: The not completely good, whose destination is the Earthly Paradise.

name: Judgment Day
description: End of days when souls in the Earthly Paradise enter Heaven.

name: Hermetic necromancy
description: Magic unable to question those given a Church burial.

name: Wizard's March
description: Hermetic condemnation of a magus, e.g. for Infernalism.

name: Infernalism
description: Dealing with the Infernal; grounds for a Wizard's March.

name: Hermetic longevity ritual
description: Ritual that expires when Pasiel inflicts an aging crisis.

name: Might
description: Supernatural power score of creatures and souls (Divine, Infernal, or Magic).

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to supernatural effects; demons gain +8 from Purgatory's aura.

name: Confidence Score
description: Score that adds spiritual armor to souls' Might.

name: The Gift
description: Gives the souls of magi a Magic Might.

name: Mercurian rituals
description: Ritual magic of the Cult of Mercury, texts of which influenced Bonisagus.

name: Mercurian portal
description: Ancient functioning portal of the Cult of Mercury linking to the temple ruins.

name: Antistes Mercuria
description: Title of the high priest of Mercury held by Augustus and Tiberius.

name: Pontifex Maximus
description: Title of the high priest of the Cult of Jupiter taken by Augustus.

name: Divine
description: Realm of God; source of Divine auras and the gate to Purgatory.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons; Purgatory lies in an Infernal regio.

name: Magic
description: Realm of magic; the temple lies in a Magic regio.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of faeries, present at the battlefield.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art referenced in powers or spells in this text.

name: Heat of the Searing Forge
description: Spell whose effect continually afflicts metal-bearers in Tartaran regiones.

name: Piercing the Faerie Veil
description: Spell; a Divine version could help cross the Bridge to Paradise.

name: Pains of the Perpetual Worry
description: Spell mirrored by the Iurgatores' Whispers Behind the Back power.

name: The Earth's Carbuncle
description: Spell a gigantic version of which seems to have shattered the amphitheater.

name: Leap of Homecoming
description: Spell type usable to enter or exit the temple regio.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: Effect granted by Brother Bressal's Divine Form, Penetration 13.

name: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great
description: Meditation/Understanding miraculous effect (Level 15) revealing whether to choose a lot.

name: Then a spirit passed before my face
description: Meditation/Intervention miraculous effect (Level 25) making spirits and souls visible.

name: For thou hast power of life and death
description: Purity/Intervention miraculous effect (Level 40) opening a doorway into Purgatory.

name: Coagulation
description: Demonic power letting a demon form a physical body.

name: Obsession
description: Demonic power inflicting a Personality Trait such as Cowardly or Guilt-Ridden.

name: Betrayal of the Heart
description: Iurgator power revealing a secret fact about a target.

name: Whispers Behind the Back
description: Iurgator power causing anxiety about secret sins for a month.

name: Punish the Sinner
description: Pasiel's power inflicting wounds according to sin.

name: Duke of Purgatory (power)
description: Pasiel's constant power boosting Might against control within Purgatory.

name: Break Time's Arrow
description: Pasiel's power moving a creature to a past state.

name: Time's Former Glory
description: Pasiel's power reverting himself to restore Might or cure wounds.

name: Decay of Eleven Score Years
description: Pasiel's power aging non-living objects to dust.

name: Time Waits for No Man
description: Pasiel's power inflicting aging on living things.

name: Bellow
description: Maze Beast power penalizing Quickness rolls of listeners.

name: Sense of Self
description: Maze Beast power letting him find his way to any remembered place.
